author: Loo
body:
This man right here is a tournament winner. One of his prizes was a badge. The badge is the cheapest badge you can buy in the shop and it doesn't even come with perks. Can we at least get a badge that's not in the shop or at least something more expensive? I can play for a couple of hours and get 10,000 credits and buy the badge but do you think a couple of hours of hard work is enough to win a tournament? Well , yes it is more than enough but that's not my point. #BlackLivesMatter #ForRyan #RinnBeOriginalAndStopStealingSkins

Also my Media rank overwrites my tourney badge and I don't like that
